meta.name: agentic-eval
meta.description:
Patterns and techniques for evaluating and improving AI agent outputs. Use this skill when:
- Implementing self-critique and reflection loops
- Building evaluator-optimizer pipelines for quality-critical generation
- Creating test-driven code refinement workflows
- Designing rubric-based or LLM-as-judge evaluation systems
- Adding iterative improvement to agent outputs (code, reports, analysis)
- Measuring and improving agent response quality

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并迭代优化AI智能体的输出质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地评估和改进AI智能体的输出效果。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and iteratively improve AI agent output quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically evaluate and improve AI agent outputs.

howto.what: 该技能让AI在完成任务后自动自我评估和改进输出，通过反思循环、评估器-优化器等方法，反复检查并优化结果，直到满足标准或达到最大迭代次数。
howto.when: 当你要求生成需要高准确度的代码、报告或分析，或任务有明确评估标准时，该技能会触发AI进行迭代优化。

say.text: 请写一段Python代码，然后自我检查并改进，直到符合要求。
say.note: AI会生成代码，运行测试并修复错误。

say.text: 生成一份市场分析报告，并对照准确性和清晰度进行自评和优化。
say.note: AI会评估并迭代改进报告。

howto.what_en: This skill enables the AI to self-evaluate and improve its outputs using reflection loops, evaluator-optimizer pipelines, and iterative refinement until criteria are met or max iterations reached.
howto.when_en: When you request high-accuracy outputs like code, reports, or analysis, or when tasks have clear evaluation criteria, this skill triggers iterative self-improvement.

say_en.text: Write Python code, then self-critique and refine until it passes tests.
say_en.note: AI generates code, runs tests, and fixes errors.

say_en.text: Generate a market analysis report, self-evaluate for accuracy and clarity, then optimize.
say_en.note: AI evaluates and iteratively improves the report.
